title: Jubilant Nutty Japanese Cottage Cheese Ehomaki
description: A satvik-friendly, nutty, and fluffy Japanese dish featuring cottage cheese, served in a large ehomaki roll. This monsoon-inspired dish is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to package instructions and set aside to cool.
Drain and crumble the cottage cheese into a bowl.
In a small saucepan, combine the pasta water and sesame oil, and heat over low heat until warm.
Add the chopped walnuts to the pasta water mixture and stir to combine.
Add the pickled ginger and salt to the cottage cheese and stir to combine.
Add the warm pasta water mixture to the cottage cheese mixture and stir until smooth and creamy.
Lay a nori sheet flat on a cutting board and spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the nori, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Spread the cottage cheese mixture over the sushi rice, leaving a small border at the top.
Roll the ehomaki using a bamboo sushi mat, applying gentle pressure to form a compact roll.
Slice the ehomaki into 8 equal pieces and serve immediately.
